objective: Determine whether the surviving OOO scalar quotient is generated by, factors through, or is materially organized by winning-line orientation provenance under discrete vertical support/precedence, with raw H,V,D+,D- provenance preserved until horizontal-reflection equivalence is verified.

semanticGuard.gravityLanguage: Use discrete vertical precedence/support order only: h_c -> h_c+1, unique playable frontier, release depth, frontier accessibility, phase.

provenancePipeline: Generate every geometric K-line with raw orientation H,V,D+,D- and stable line identity.
For q_o residualization, attach every surviving residual mask to the complete set of source K-lines whose current residual equals that mask.
Duplicate residual masks merge by union of source-line provenance; strict-superset absorption deletes the absorbed residual and its provenance.
R, F, and G filter provenance records exactly when their residual mask is filtered.
Componentization follows surviving residual-mask column incidence exactly.

ROLE_CAPPAR_REL_INC canonicalization is reproduced unchanged as the base descriptor; orientation provenance is carried in a parallel canonical occurrence record and is not allowed to alter the base descriptor.
ZOE and OOO remain the existing count and oddness coordinates; orientation summaries annotate the frozen OOO carrier rather than selecting outcome-dependent coordinates.

requiredExactCheck: horizontal reflection exchanges D+ and D-
q_o, R, F, G, componentization, role capacity parity, and relative-depth incidence commute with horizontal reflection under the corresponding column permutation
reflectionControl.quotientAfterPass: Only after all structural reflection checks pass may D+ and D- be folded to D for the H/V/D candidate ladder.

descriptorOrientationSummaries.name: ORI_PRESENCE
descriptorOrientationSummaries.definition: Per base ROLE_CAPPAR descriptor identity, the frozen set of occurrence-variant orientation-presence masks after folding D+/- to D.

descriptorOrientationSummaries.name: ORI_COUNTS
descriptorOrientationSummaries.definition: Frozen set of occurrence variants of total source-line provenance count vector (n_H,n_V,n_D).

descriptorOrientationSummaries.name: OWNER_ORI_COUNTS
descriptorOrientationSummaries.definition: Frozen set of occurrence variants of owner-separated orientation count vectors.

descriptorOrientationSummaries.name: ORI_ROLE_PHASE_COUNTS
descriptorOrientationSummaries.definition: Frozen set of occurrence variants counting source-provenance residual cells by orientation family and role-attached capacity-parity bit.

descriptorOrientationSummaries.name: ORI_DEPTH_HISTOGRAM
descriptorOrientationSummaries.definition: Frozen set of occurrence variants of exact frontier-relative depth histograms separated by H,V,D.

descriptorOrientationSummaries.name: OWNER_ORI_DEPTH_HISTOGRAM
descriptorOrientationSummaries.definition: Frozen set of occurrence variants of owner x orientation x exact relative-depth histograms.

descriptorOrientationSummaries.name: PAIR_ORI_INCIDENCE
descriptorOrientationSummaries.definition: Frozen set of occurrence variants counting local columns on which each unordered pair among H,V,D has surviving provenance incidence.

descriptorOrientationSummaries.name: OWNER_ORI_PHASE_DEPTH
descriptorOrientationSummaries.definition: Frozen set of occurrence variants of owner x orientation x role-phase x exact-depth residual-cell counts.

descriptorOrientationSummaries.name: EXACT_ORIENTATION_PROVENANCE
descriptorOrientationSummaries.definition: Frozen set of canonical occurrence variants retaining owner, residual-mask grouping, relative-depth/local-role cells, raw H/V/D+/D- source-orientation multiplicities.

descriptorOrientationSummaries.name: FULL_DESCRIPTOR_PLUS_EXACT_ORIENTATION
descriptorOrientationSummaries.definition: Base ROLE_CAPPAR descriptor plus EXACT_ORIENTATION_PROVENANCE; reconstruction control.

tripleClassification.method: Map each frozen OOO triple descriptor vertex to its descriptor-level orientation-summary variant-set label; classify the unordered triple of labels mechanically.
tripleClassification.mixedCategory: MIXED is used when one or more descriptor orientation envelopes are not singleton H/V/D.

hvdPredicate.name: T_HVD
hvdPredicate.definition: For one OOO triple, T_HVD=1 iff the union of the three descriptor orientation-presence envelopes contains H, V, and folded D.
tests: rank of dependency residue restricted to HVD triples
scalar contradiction count and scalar-image dimension using HVD-only residue
scalar contradiction count and scalar-image dimension using non-HVD-only residue
whether HVD-only triples alone preserve scalar factorization
whether removing HVD triples preserves scalar factorization

crossKControl.primaryComparison: 6x3-k3 versus 6x3-k4: identical board geometry, different connect length.
measurements: intersection of orientation-derived OOO triple keys for each candidate
candidate scalar factorization disposition in k=3 versus k=4
whether a common orientation-derived candidate is exact on both k values
crossKControl.interpretation: Shared exact orientation structure across k=3 and k=4 supports an orientation-family explanation over a k-1 companion-count explanation; incompatibility is evidence against it.

shuffledControls.method: For each candidate, deterministically cyclically reassign descriptor orientation-summary labels among sorted base descriptor identities while keeping the multiset of labels fixed; use shifts 1, 3, and 7 modulo descriptor count.
shuffledControls.purpose: Test whether orientation labels carry structure beyond arbitrary relabelling.
shuffledControls.falsifier: If shuffled controls preserve scalar factorization comparably to the true orientation labels, orientation provenance is not supported as the organizing explanation.

dtsQuestions: Under one column advance, compare H, V, D+, D- residual provenance transformations through cofactor/block/delete/R/F/G.
Verify H is transverse to the support chain, V lies in one support chain, and D couples column displacement to support depth.
Measure whether orientation-channel transition signatures close to a smaller three-channel exchange/circuit carrier.
structuralControls: Base ROLE_CAPPAR class counts and EW-RS-065 matched-dependency ranks must reproduce.
Provenance-preserving q_o/RFG mask projections must exactly equal the existing mask-only q_o/RFG pipeline.
No orientation summary may alter T2 classification or the base repaired coordinate.
antiCircularity: All orientation labels come from geometric winning-line generation before any W/D/L computation.
The provenance propagation rules, reflection test, candidate ladder, HVD predicate, cross-k measurements, shuffle controls, and MSS removal order are frozen before scalar qualification.
No orientation category, descriptor split, source line, or exception is selected using scalar outcomes.
Scalar codes are replayed only after each candidate structural map and basis is frozen.
EW-RS-059 PRIMARY 3x6-k4 and BACKUP 5x3-k4 remain sealed.
falsifiers: Orientation provenance has too little structural image rank to carry the scalar dependency image.
k=3 and k=4 require incompatible orientation-derived candidate structures.
Full owner x orientation x phase x depth summaries still fail to separate scalar-bearing dependencies.
Deterministically shuffled orientation controls preserve scalar factorization comparably to true provenance.
A strictly simpler non-orientation structural carrier subsumes the same quotient with no orientation-dependent residual information.
interpretationGuards: Triadic OOO persistence across k values is a clue, not evidence by itself that H/V/D is causal.
Reflection quotient D+~D- is admitted only after exact structural verification.
A passing orientation-derived feature family is bounded Q-V evidence, not a universal law.
No Q-A/Q-F, standard-7x6, universal cubic, or center-opening claim follows.
